title.en: Socratic wisdom: knowing that one does not know
title.nl: Socratische wijsheid: weten dat je niets weet

summary.fa: در دفاعیهٔ افلاطون، سقراط می‌گوید برتری او بر دیگران فقط این است که چیزی را که نمی‌داند، دانسته نمی‌پندارد. این نوعی فروتنی معرفتی است: دانش کامل از آنِ خدا و دانایی انسان محدود است.
summary.en: In Plato's Apology, Socrates claims his only edge over others is that he does not think he knows what he does not know. It is a form of epistemic humility: complete knowledge belongs to the divine and human wisdom is limited.
summary.nl: In Plato's Apologie stelt Socrates dat zijn enige voorsprong is dat hij niet denkt te weten wat hij niet weet: een vorm van epistemische bescheidenheid.

text.fa: دوست سقراط، کرفون، از پیشگویی دلفی پرسید آیا کسی داناتر از سقراط هست و پاسخ آمد که نه. سقراط این پاسخ را معمایی دانست، چون خود را بی‌دانش می‌شمرد.
text.en: Socrates' friend Chaerephon asked the Delphic oracle whether anyone was wiser than Socrates and was told no. Socrates took this as a riddle, since he considered himself without wisdom.
text.nl: Socrates' friend Chaerephon asked the Delphic oracle whether anyone was wiser than Socrates and was told no. Socrates took this as a riddle, since he considered himself without wisdom.

text.fa: برای حل معما نزد سیاستمداران، شاعران و پیشه‌وران رفت و آنان را آزمود. بیشترِ آنان که به دانایی شهرت داشتند، به چیزهایی که نمی‌دانستند ادعای دانایی می‌کردند.
text.en: To solve the riddle he questioned politicians, poets and craftsmen. Most of those reputed to be wise claimed knowledge of things they did not know.
text.nl: To solve the riddle he questioned politicians, poets and craftsmen. Most of those reputed to be wise claimed knowledge of things they did not know.

text.fa: نتیجهٔ او: دانایی بشر در برابر دانایی راستین ناچیز است، و داناترین آدم کسی است که این را بپذیرد. شاعران را هم نه صاحب دانش، بلکه برخوردار از استعداد و الهام می‌داند.
text.en: His conclusion: human wisdom is of little worth beside true wisdom, and the wisest person is the one who admits this. He also treats the poets as inspired rather than knowledgeable.
text.nl: His conclusion: human wisdom is of little worth beside true wisdom, and the wisest person is the one who admits this. He also treats the poets as inspired rather than knowledgeable.

text.fa: نتیجهٔ سقراط بخشی از نگاه فلسفی افلاطون است. این‌که «اعتراف به نادانی» تا چه حد فروتنی صادقانه و تا چه حد شیوه‌ای بیانی (طنز سقراطی) بوده، میان پژوهشگران محل بحث است.
text.en: Socrates' conclusion is part of Plato's philosophical picture. How far this confession of ignorance was sincere humility and how far a rhetorical device (Socratic irony) is debated among scholars.
text.nl: Socrates' conclusion is part of Plato's philosophical picture. How far this confession of ignorance was sincere humility and how far a rhetorical device (Socratic irony) is debated among scholars.

note.fa: تحلیل مدرن چیستیِ دانستن در برابر ادعای سقراط دربارهٔ مرز دانستن
note.en: Modern analysis of what knowing is, set against Socrates' claim about the limits of knowing
